text:
Fiona (Product): Heads-up: launching BYO-Image Verification v1 for Private/VPC tonight at 02:00 UTC. Purpose: allow customers to use their own signed container/model images while the agent enforces signature provenance and runtime attestation. This is aimed at regulated customers requiring supply-chain verification.

Hector (Eng): Quick tech notes: agent verifies image signatures against a customer-uploaded trust store (PEM keys or KMS signer ids). Verification happens at pull-time and at periodic attest checks. Example register call: ```curl -X POST https://127.0.0.1:8443/agent/images/verify -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>' -d '{"image_ref":"registry.acme.com/model:1.2","signature":"BASE64_SIG","signer_kid":"acme-key-2026"}'``` If verification fails the agent rejects image activation and emits a signed rejection bundle.

Lena (SRE): Rollout plan: canary 8 customers 02:00-02:20 UTC. Monitoring: image_verify_fail_rate, attestation_mismatch_rate, agent_restart_rate. Rollback criteria: verify_fail >0.3% OR unexpected agent restarts > 0.5% in 10m. I'll post live metrics.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for byo-image-verify-v1 at 2026-09-10T02:00Z.

Fiona (Product): Action items: Security - confirm threat model & rejection-bundle fields; Legal - approve customer-facing wording; Support - KB + canned replies; Sales - 1-liner + canary customer list so CSMs can proactively reach out.

Carl (Security): Threat model notes: verify we sign the attestation result with agent signer_kid and include upstream registry fingerprint, manifest_sha256, signer_kid, and a timestamp. Rejection bundles must include the failure reason, unsigned manifest, and suggested remediation steps. Security OK pending SRE metrics.

Marta (Legal): Need contract-safe language: we verify signatures against customer-supplied trust anchors; we do not assert the image's functional behavior or third-party code provenance beyond signature verification. Request short audit sentence: 'Agent verifies image signatures against customer trust anchors and emits a signed attest/ rejection bundle for audit.'

Ibrahim (Sales): Can we get a 20-word blurb for customer outreach and a short FAQ example? Also need the canary list for CSM outreach.

Hector (Eng): Draft blurb: 'Use your signed images on Private/VPC; the agent enforces signature provenance and emits signed attestations for audits.' Full FAQ to #docs after GA.

Lena (SRE): Canary update @02:12: 8 image pulls verified, 0 verification failures, attestations emitted, median verify time 160ms. Promoting to staged rollout at 02:25.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Staged rollout initiated for byo-image-verify-v1 at 2026-09-10T02:26Z.

Zoey (Support): I'll add KB: 'Register trust anchors; verify image attestations; troubleshoot verification errors' with steps: check trust store, confirm signer_kid mapping, collect agent attestation bundle, escalate to SRE with bundle_id. Will post link when live.

Fiona (Product): Post-rollout follow-ups: (1) Sales outreach template (Ibrahim), (2) a small security FAQ section (Carl), (3) SRE dashboard panels for image_verify_fail and attestation_age (Lena). GA announcement planned tomorrow 16:00 UTC after Legal + Support link.

Hector (Eng): Follow-ups: we need a small e2e test in CI that verifies a signed image path and rejection path. I'll open a PR and tag @Hector.

Lena (SRE): If any customer sees image activation failures tag #eng-oncall and include the attestation bundle_id. I'll add alerts to the runbook: https://redir.company/runbooks/byo-image-verify.

Fiona (Product): Thanks everyone. If anything odd in next 48h ping #eng-oncall and tag @Fiona. I'll post the final GA draft here once Support + Legal confirm the KB and wording.
